name: Oral

queries.query: Oral Kazakhstan official cadastral map parcel GIS cadastral Oral Kazakhstan
queries.result: First-party discovery located the official West Kazakhstan geoportal announcement, the national NSDI geoportal, and the state land-cadastre service documentation. The regional announcement says the geoportal publishes land-parcel layers derived from the automated state land cadastre, but no public feature endpoint was verified.

queries.query: Орал қаласы жер кадастры кадастрлық карта ресми GIS
queries.result: Ресми Батыс Қазақстан геопорталы туралы хабарламада Орал қаласының жер учаскелері жөніндегі мемлекеттік жер кадастрының автоматтандырылған ақпараттық жүйесі деректері жарияланғаны көрсетілген. Мемлекеттік кадастр картасының JavaScript конфигурациясындағы анонимді ArcGIS прокси маршруты тексерілді, бірақ 404 қайтарды; идентификатор мен полигоннан тұратын шектелген жауап алынбады.

registryEvidence.custodian: The West Kazakhstan regional land-relations authority publishes the geoportal; the Oral city land-relations department is evidenced as the local municipal custodian in official government material. The national AIS State Land Cadastre service is the central technical/state-cadastre custodian.
registryEvidence.scope: A real regional/municipal cadastral map and land-parcel publication is evidenced. This establishes a local registry/map lead, not an admitted open parcel-vector adapter or citywide completeness.

parcelDiscovery.source: West Kazakhstan geoportal / AIS State Land Cadastre public map lead

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 official regional announcement. It states that 62 thematic layers are published and that land-parcel data from the automated state land-cadastre information system were obtained and published for the geoportal, with updates based on aerial photography. It did not expose a bounded feature API in the page response.

HTTP 200 official NSDI viewer. Inline configuration exposed the public GeoServer base https://map.gov.kz/geoserver/ and catalogue https://map.gov.kz/catalogue/csw. WMS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 200, but no cadastral-parcel vector layer suitable for safe ID+geometry retrieval was identified.
HTTP 200 official AIS State Land Cadastre map page. JavaScript exposed the cadastral map proxy route /aisgzk/Proxy/aisgzkZem2/MapServer and the viewer's ArcGIS layer model.
HTTP 404 HTML response. The same route with /0, /1, and /2 layer suffixes also returned HTTP 404. No geometry, schema, CRS, native ID, or safe field response was retained.
HTTP 200 WMS capabilities document. The inspected layer names did not yield a cadastral parcel feature layer; WMS imagery/land-use discovery is not treated as parcel verification.

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as an absence test. No exact-point parcel query was issued after the exposed service route failed; a 404, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide absence.

uncertainty: The local/regional registry custodian and public cadastral-map publication are evidenced, but the anonymous parcel service route did not return a usable response.
Native parcel IDs, CRS, polygon geometry, safe field schema, and citywide coverage remain unverified.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No sample GeoJSON was written because no safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was returned.
Packet completion is not source integration or runtime admission.
